lines.text: Many learners say: I will go to there tomorrow.
Better: I will go there tomorrow.
There needs no to. Say go there.

data.wrong: I will go to there tomorrow.
data.why: There needs no to. Say go there.

native.tip: there 本身就表示“到那里”，go 后面直接接 there，不加 to。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I will go to there tomorrow.”😅 英语的 there 已经包含“到那里”，不用再加 to：“I will go there tomorrow.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I will go there tomorrow.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: There already includes the idea of to, so say go there.
en.caption: Do you say “I will go to there tomorrow.” 😅 There already includes the idea of to: “I will go there tomorrow.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
